channel.title: The Valley Times-News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Valley Times-News (valleytimes-news.com)

item.title: LaFayette City Council reviews project options
item.description: LaFayette council weighs a $2 million waterline project against tight grant deadlines and ALDOT’s paving schedule, balancing cost risks with aging pipes.

item.title: Community partnering for Black history events
item.description: Hawkes Library, West Point Housing Authority and Point University’s Skyhawk Servant Leaders are partnering together to host several events for the community in honor of Black History Month.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - John Tures: Honor The Linemen, Both The Super Bowl Heroes And Saviors During Ice Storms
item.description: As Super Bowl hype builds and ice storms hit the South, John Tures highlights the overlooked linemen—on the field and on power lines—whose work restores power and shapes the biggest games.

item.title: GVACC hosts fundraiser for first responders
item.description: BBQ “Battle of the Badges” cook-off and Leprechaun Ride on March 14 will bring Valley first responders and families together to raise funds for local law enforcement and community initiatives.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - L. Michelle Moore: Can Wind Power Reduce Energy Costs?
item.description: UK wind power has cut energy bills by $140B and now supplies 30% of its energy. So why is the far wind-richer US lagging, with projects stalled by federal opposition?

item.title: Southern Union’s Therapeutic Massage Program prepares students for in-demand wellness careers
item.description: Southern Union State Community College is enrolling for its three-semester Therapeutic Massage Program in Opelika, training students for LMT careers.

item.title: Rotary hears updates on West Point Elementary
item.description: West Point Elementary principal outlines the school’s mission, progress and challenges, including PBIS programs, Title I support and a coming on-campus pediatric clinic, in a Rotary Club update.

item.title: Springwood boys advance to Elite Eight
item.description: The Springwood varsity boys are heading back to the Elite Eight after a 61-59 win against Fort Dale Academy in overtime during the first round of the state playoffs.

item.title: LaFayette boys cruise past Reeltown to area championship game
item.description: LaFayette routs Reeltown 69-34 to reach area title game and set up Monday rivalry rematch with Lanett in LaFayette.

item.title: Lanett boys headed to area championship game after overtime win
item.description: Lanett boys edge Loachapoka 64-60 in OT, rallying late to reach the area title game vs rival LaFayette and clinch a spot in the state playoffs.
